description: Darken Rahl's death leaves a tear in the veil to the Underworld, allowing the Keeper to send banelings and the dead back into the world. Richard, Kahlan and Zedd are joined by Mord-Sith Cara and search for the Stone of Tears, the only artifact capable of sealing the rift. Along the way Kahlan learns she is the last Confessor, Richard's heritage makes him a target for competing powers, and the Keeper repeatedly tries to corrupt the group before the Stone can be delivered and the veil repaired.

s02e01.description: In the riveting second season premiere, Richard discovers that in defeating the sinister tyrant Darken Rahl, victory is short-lived when he inadvertently opens a rift to the underworld, unleashing an even greater evil on the world of the living. As Richard, Kahlan and Zedd prepare for a quest to find the Stone of Tears, the only force that can close the rift, Triana, a defiant Mord'Sith, challenges Cara's authority.

s02e02.description: The quest for the Stone of Tears brings Richard, Kahlan, Zedd and Cara to a D'Haran prison where the dead return from the underworld to prey on the living. But as the Seeker races to stop the senseless killing, he discovers that someone who holds the key to locating the all-important Stone, which will seal the rift to the underworld, has struck a deadly deal of his own.

s02e03.description: Richard sends Cara away to excape the wrath of Kahlan when it's revealed that the Mord'Sith is responsible for the death of someone very close to the Confessor. But upon Cara's return to her hometown village, local townspeople put the Mord'Sith on trial for the horrific crimes she's committed in the past. With Cara's fate now completely in Kahlan's hands, the Confessor must make a life-or-death decision.

s02e04.description: While Zedd and Cara follow a lead in tracking down the Stone of Tears, Kahlan learns of a mysterious girl who proves to be the only other living Confessor. She and Richard set out to rescue the teenager from evil forces and prevent her from accidentally unleashing the power she possesses.

s02e05.description: Zedd falls victim to a mysterious spell that strips him of his memory - and his old age. Emboldened by his newfound youth, the once-wise wizard is convinced he must replace Richard with a new Seeker to find the Stone of Tears and save a town threatened by a rift to the Underworld. Now, it's up to Richard, Kahlan and Cara to rescue a powerful and arrogant young Zedd from a lethal showdown with Darken Rahl and the Keeper of the Underworld.

s02e06.description: Richard and Cara help a small group of villagers escape ruthless slave traders, killing the aggressors in the process. The deaths disappoint the matriarch of the victimized people, a pacifist group called the Minders. Some of them, though, are tired of turning the other cheek while they are being subjugated and slaughtered, and enlist the Seeker's aid in showing them how to protect themselves against future attacks. But Richard's attempt to teach the Minders self-defense skills unleashes their building rage, which threatens to consume them and destroy the Seeker.

s02e07.description: In the wake of Darken Rahl's death, one of his commanders, General Grix, tries to claim the throne of D'Hara for himself and eliminate anyone who could challenge him, including Richard Cypher, the rightful heir. Kahlan and Zedd track Grix's D'Haran soldiers, who plan to threaten his rivals with deadly force. Meanwhile, Richard and Cara track Grix to a brothel run by Denna, the Mord'Sith who once tried to eliminate the Seeker for Rahl. Richard soon discovers he is to be an unwilling pawn in Denna's deadly plot to control the throne herself, a scheme in which he may pay the ultimate price.

s02e08.description: Denna steals the compass needed to locate the Stone of Tears and escapes with Zedd as her prisoner. While pursuing them, Richard is crippled by headaches caused by his emerging wizard powers; the Sisters of the Light tell him that survival requires training at the Palace of the Prophets, forcing him to leave the search for Zedd to Kahlan and Cara.

s02e09.description: At the Palace of the Prophets, Richard trains with the Sisters of the Light and learns from Sister Nicci that their intentions toward him are not what they appear. With Richard unavailable, Zedd accepts that another Seeker must carry the Sword of Truth and joins Kahlan and Cara in finding his replacement, while Richard forms an uneasy alliance with Nicci inside the Palace.

s02e10.description: Trapped in the deadly Valley of Perdition, Richard's worst fears come magically to life and threaten to kill him. Enduring powerful and disturbing visions about those he holds dear, Richard is forced to make gut-wrenching choices that test his will, tempt his sense of right and wrong, and take him to the brink of death. Meanwhile, the world's most powerful sorceress, Sister Nicci, plots to murder Kahlan, who leads Zedd, Cara and the new Seeker, Leo, on a quest to find Richard. During their long journey, Cara's deepening feelings for Leo bring her to an emotional crossroads.

s02e11.description: When Kahlan's homeland of Aydindril is taken over by the ruthless Prince Fyren. she and Zedd realize they must go to the legendary city to reclaim it from the tyrant, leaving Richard and Cara to continue the search for the Stone of Tears. However, when a magical accident occurs that seems to have stripped Kahlan of her powers, Richard soon realizes the situation is more complex--and dangerous--than it first appears.

s02e12.description: While the Keeper wages war on the living, Richard, Kahlan, Zedd and Cara set out to rescue a group of villagers who may have been kidnapped by banelings -- dead souls returned from the Underworld by the Keeper in exchange for killing someone every day to stay alive. As the rescue attempt grows intense, Cara proposes a deadly covenant with the ruthless Darken Rahl to protect the Seeker. Meanwhile, a dubious magic peddler strikes a deal with Zedd's wayward brother to sell a potion that might threaten Rahl's plan and cure banelings of their bloodlust once and for all.

s02e13.description: The Sisters of the Dark conjure the world's most powerful sorceress, Sister Nicci, back from the Underworld, and she brings with her a scheme to help the Keeper put an end to all life. The evil Sister Nicci negotiates a deadly deal with the richest man alive, the Margrave of Rothenberg. To fulfill his end of the bargain, the Margrave captures Kahlan and prepares her for delivery to the Keeper. A spell cast over the Margrave's land prevents anyone from using magic to free the Confessor. Learning that the Margrave is planning to choose a new bride, Richard and Zedd devise a plan to infiltrate the protected realm and rescue Kahlan. Posing as refined royalty, with the Seeker and Wizard disguised as her entourage, a reluctant Cara must compete in an elaborate masquerade of manners to win the chauvinistic Margrave's affections - before the Sisters of the Dark arrive and claim his prisoner for her deadly date with the Keeper.

s02e14.description: After failing to kill Kahlan, Sister Nicci is hunted by both the Sisters of the Dark and Darken Rahl. She casts a spell binding her life directly to Kahlan's, making any attack on Nicci fatal to the Mother Confessor and forcing Richard to protect his enemy while leading her toward the Stone of Tears. Kahlan seeks help from her estranged father to break the bond.

s02e15.description: A powerful woman claiming to be the Creator accuses Richard of serving the Keeper and places the Seeker on trial. Kahlan, Cara and Zedd investigate the claimant's identity to expose the deception and save Richard, while Darken Rahl treats her appearance as a threat of his own and prepares to eliminate her.

s02e16.description: A birthday celebration for Richard goes horribly wrong when a grief-stricken magician unleashes a lethal plan to avenge the unjust deaths of his sons, killed in the war against Darken Rahl. To exact revenge on those responsible, the conflicted conjurer traps Kahlan and Cara in a tomb and causes the release of a bloodthirsty Nygaax - a mummy ruled by dark magic. Now, with time and air running out, it's up to the Seeker to rescue the Confessor and Cara. Meanwhile, an even deadlier fate awaits Zedd upon the arrival of the Nygaax.

s02e17.description: Zedd's brother Thaddicus discovers that their father's killer, who was assumed to have perished at the hand of Darken Rahl, is still alive. Upon learning the grim news, Zedd leaves Richard, Kahlan and Cara, reuniting with Thaddicus on a secret quest to avenge their father's murder. While the siblings attempt to find the person both they and Rahl want dead, the Seeker's hunt for the Stone of Tears leads him to befriend a stranger who claims he's uncovered secrets crucial to Richard's quest. But the real mystery surrounding this man sends Richard and Zedd on a collision course with the past - and each other.

s02e18.description: When a Sister of the Dark steals an ancient scroll containing secrets critical to their quest for the Stone of Tears, Richard, Kahlan, Zedd and Cara set out to recover the all-important document and thwart the Keeper's deadly scheme to destroy all life. Meanwhile, Darken Rahl grows weary of his tenure in the Underworld and hatches a lethal plot to return to the land of the living using a hapless lookalike named Walter - a plan which could require the unwilling assistance of the Seeker.

s02e19.description: Newly resurrected Darken Rahl plans to stay alive by using the secrets of an ancient scroll to defy the Keeper, forcing Richard into an uneasy alliance with Rahl to find the Stone of Tears and defeat the Keeper once and for all. Elsewhere, Kahlan and Cara fight to save the last of a species all but wiped out by Rahl's scheme, while the Keeper dispatches the deadly Sisters of the Dark to return Rahl to the Underworld.

s02e20.description: Led by a magical compass to the location of the Stone of Tears, Richard and Kahlan enter a mysterious, hidden valley. They find it occupied by a people whose sole purpose is to guard the object of the Seeker's arduous search, and discover it's a land from which they cannot leave. Meanwhile, outside the valley Cara's reunion with a woman from her past leads her and Zedd into a deadly trap.

s02e21.description: The Seeker is in a race against time to regain control of the Stone of Tears from Darken Rahl and prevent the Keeper's imminent victory over the world of living. After an intense battle, Richard captures Cara, whom Darken Rahl turned against him, and Zedd attempts to reverse the insidious dark magic that caused the Mord'Sith to betray her friends. But the wizard's powerful spell instead drastically alters the lives of Richard, Kahlan and everyone else.

s02e22.description: Richard reaches the Pillars of Creation with the Stone of Tears and attempts to seal the rifts allowing the Keeper's influence into the world. Separated from his companions, he is forced into a final confrontation over the Stone while Sister Nicci takes control of Kahlan and sends the Mother Confessor against the people trying to stop the Keeper.
